checks.name: Mixed fields retain XML run order and use display numbering starting at zero
Field-only paragraphs preserve every field
Display numbering does not change navigation indices
Two consecutive authored breaks survive
Bitmap alpha scales only image pixels
Picture horizontal flip applies around the picture viewport
Custom geometry and image flip share a coordinate system
Zero opacity remains fully transparent
Percentage-form image alpha is interpreted as a percentage
Layout paint stays above master regardless of part-local order
Vertical flip keeps the authored crop inside the transformed custom mask
Repeated alpha modulation composes without erasing intrinsic image alpha
Alpha amplification acts on pixel alpha rather than CSS opacity clamping
Amplification then attenuation preserves intermediate alpha saturation
Picture rotation composes with its authored local flip
Slide-local drawing remains above layout and master stacking contexts
First-slide metadata accepts the full signed schema range and rejects malformed values
Mixed XML sequence retains field styling without mutating shared layout nodes
Malformed alpha never injects markup or non-finite filter coefficients
Actual classic Worker retains display numbers, field order, breaks and picture effects
Sequential document load resets display numbering (7)
Sequential document load resets display numbering (-1)
Sequential document load resets display numbering (null)
Master visibility suppression leaves layout paint and slide text intact
Public PptxViewer resolves the real Worker, sanitizes SVG filters and preserves drawing semantics
No uncaught browser errors or external requests
